shared_elements: quadruped animal in profile carved in low relief
horizontal register or band separating zones
animal shown lying/crouching beneath or below another element
justification: Both surfaces show quadruped animals in strict profile rendered in shallow relief, with a large animal figure occupying the field and a horizontal banded register organising the composition, and both use fairly schematic outlined bodies with sparse interior detail. But the depicted subjects differ substantially: A shows a large hoofed/legged beast with a slender crouching animal lying beneath its belly in a single naturalistic scene, while B stacks distinct motifs (a row of arched shapes over a fringed band, a downward-facing quadruped, a bird-headed creature, a branch/plant motif and a large long-necked bird) in unrelated vertical panels.
